g.text: Fee replacement: a new version of the same nonce, committed before it is broadcast
payment: Sent · bump → Sent, Sent · cancel_replace → Sent (C2, C6, C7, C11, C13, C21; H-124, H-175, H-199; nonce-and-crash spike sections 6 and 7)
payment I is Sent: version v1 {nonce n, maxFee f1, tip p1, raw1, hash1}
[no receipt after k polls, or maxFee f1 below the current base fee]
[f2 within the fee reserve held for I (C11)]
before any broadcast of raw2 (C6), synced to disk (C21): a kill or a power loss
here leaves v2 stored or never sent; PaymentLane_bug_C21bump finds a double
payment when this sync is left out
any version's receipt settles the payment (C6); row: Sent · receipt [blk == 'own'] → Included
The owner cancels a sent payment
row: Sent · receipt [blk == 'own' or blk == 'own_cancel'] → Included
row: Included · finality [blk_fin and blk == 'own_cancel'] → Cancelled (Settle)
row: Included · finality [blk_fin and blk != 'own_cancel' and blk_ok] → Confirmed
Past the burn point a cancel can only race; it never reports "did not run" (C13, H-199):
payment Sent · cancel_or_switch_off → Sent. A mined cancel is never Confirmed, and a mined
paying version never Cancelled (PaymentLane ReportedIsTrue; races.feature).
A foreign transaction takes nonce n (the exported key used elsewhere)
Sent · receipt [blk == 'foreign' and not blk_fin] → Sent
[proven: signer == wallet, nonce == n, hash not stored, both RPCs agree]
Sent · receipt [blk == 'foreign' and blk_fin and verified] → Waiting
Sent · receipt [blk == 'foreign' and blk_fin and not verified] → Sent (LieForeign)
